changes.from:
Make ctx the shared owner of context bundle format, storage, artifact management, OCR, and portable .ctx export for Omni Agent Handoff and future tools.

Design decisions:
- Bundle storage is central and app-independent, e.g. XDG data under ctx bundles, not inside Omni repos.
- Bundle id format: timestamp + short id + optional slug, e.g. 2026-06-24T10-41-03Z_7hf3k2_build-slides.
- Bundle lifecycle: draft -> sent -> archived/cancelled; collection creates draft immediately.
- Bundle item schema includes image, text, file, url, desktop_snapshot, handoff_record.
- .ctx archive is zipped portable form for remote/Oqto upload.
- File items support copied and referenced storage; target/export decides whether references must be materialized.
- OCR belongs in ctx; v1 can shell out to `ocrs` CLI as backend.

Acceptance / proof:
- ctx can create a bundle, add images/text/files/URLs/snapshots, run OCR for an image, export .ctx, and render agent-readable context.md.
- Schemas are generated/synced to ~/byteowlz/schemas.
- Existing ctx capture behavior continues to work.
- `cargo check` and relevant tests pass.

ctx: Implement Context Bundles For Omni Agent Handoff [mock-volt-hobo]
note: Added ctx bundle CLI commands and store. ctx-core/src/store.rs provides the central bundle store (XDG bundle_dir) with deterministic id generation (timestamp+shortid+slug), create/load/save, agent-readable context.md rendering, and item/handoff/warning helpers with 11 unit tests. ctx-cli/src/bundle.rs adds 'ctx bundle {create,add-screenshot,crop-image,add-file,add-text,add-url,add-snapshot,ocr,handoff,export,show,list}' all emitting stable JSON, defensively recording warnings instead of corrupting bundles. ctx-core/src/export.rs exports portable .ctx zip archives that materialize referenced files and record unresolved refs + export metadata. Proof: shell script creates a bundle, adds text task+file+URL, records a handoff, exports .ctx, and the resulting manifest validates against ctx.bundle.schema.json (verified with jsonschema Draft7). cargo check + cargo test (34 tests) pass; existing capture behavior unchanged.

session_name: ctx: Implement Context Bundles For Omni Agent Handoff [mock-volt-hobo]
note: Added macOS capture/crop/OCR bundle backend. ctx-core/src/bundle_capture.rs implements capture modes frontmost (focused window, cropped from its display via x_win), display (main display), and all (every display) with best-effort provenance (app, window title, url, display, mode, rect, timestamp). crop_image crops by x/y/w/h and validates bounds. OCR backend shells out to the configurable command (default ocrs) and attaches OCR text items; permission/engine failures and missing images degrade to structured 'ocr_failed' warnings (4 unit tests cover the graceful paths). OCR command is configurable via [ocr] in config.toml. Design leaves room for Wayland portal / Windows capture later. cargo check + cargo test pass.

changes.to: Define and implement a lightweight ctx daemon/current-context interface for tools like eaRS dictation. Desired outcome: event sources such as tmux, shell hooks, pi, and window managers can announce current app/window/cwd/project; ctx maintains an in-memory current context and mirrors it to an atomic JSON state file under XDG runtime/state. Proof: document JSON schema/format, add tests for atomic state updates or context parsing, and provide CLI command such as ctx current --json that returns the live state quickly.
